description: NEDM2020 combines ionospheric layers with a plasmasphere formulation to describe electron density up to GNSS altitudes. DLR developed the model to support space-weather services and corrections for signal propagation. The resource is documented by German Aerospace Center (DLR). The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its layered empirical representation does not resolve every local ionospheric irregularity. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
